lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately four horizontal rows across the mid-flank. The clusters exhibit consistent spatial intervals, creating a discernible lattice structure.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance that align with the vertical columns of the circular blobs, establishing a grid-like anchor system across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features on the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity light on the dorsal-facing edge and distinct shadowing on the ventral-facing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible horizontal dark indentation running along the mid-flank parallel to the carinae. Irregular notched profile on the posterior margin of the dorsal fin. Distinct high-luminance patch on the leading edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pectoral fin displays a high-density population of small-diameter luminance points, contrasting with the larger, sparsely distributed blobs on the main lateral body.
